chk_problem.label: accurate
chk_problem.poster_evidence: Clinic notes and structured electronic health record medication history often contain different medication information. Outpatient notes may document medication starts, stops, holds, regimen changes, and formulation details that do not appear in the structured medication list at the same time. Same-visit disagreement may therefore reflect normalization errors, differences in terminology or timing, medication reconciliation practices, or actual documentation differences.
chk_problem.reason: The poster accurately describes the problem of disagreement between clinic notes and structured EHR medication history due to normalization errors, terminology differences, or timing in the 'Motivation' section.
